title: YouTube Upload Payload
description: The structured metadata payload sent to YouTube's videos.insert/videos.update endpoints. Contains only safe structured metadata — never an OAuth token/header. Titles/description/tags/chapters come exactly from the approved Step 11 publication package; no LLM call happens in this step. See docs/architecture/youtube-publication-pipeline.md#title--description.

publishAt.description: ISO8601 UTC. Requires privacyStatus=private when set — YouTube itself flips the video to public at this time.
